Name: Lycanvam Mass
Information:
**Lycanvam**

Lycanvam are dangerous alien plants that take root on planets across the cosmos, as well as seed themselves on drifting comets and space debris. They are voracious, looking to devour any life they can get their tendrils around, and have a unique ability that lets them share the traits and qualities of the creatures they are consuming, often making them resistant to the escape attempts of their prey.

**Silent Slumber.** When a lycanvam growth runs out of food to consume, it will regress into its seedling state (a mossy growth that secures itself in small, tucked-away spaces) and enters into a state of deathly hibernation until it feels the warmth of blood and life around it. It then reawakens and attempts to feed in a wild frenzy. In this suspended state it can exist for hundreds of thousands of years, resembles regular plantlife, and can survive huge impacts, such as a derelict astradeck or meteor crashing down to a planet.

traits.name: Bodily Strength
traits.description: The lycanvam mass may use its Constitution in place of Strength for any attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes, and when forced to make a Strength saving throw it may make a Constitution saving throw instead.

traits.name: Hoarding Gullet
traits.description: If the mass reduces a creature to 0 hit points while swallowing it, the creature falls unconscious, and stops taking damage from being swallowed. The creature is moved into an inner chamber in the mass’s body where it remains, being fed on for a longer period of time. The creature makes one Death saving throw every 24 hours rather than each turn while in stasis like this, only dying if they fail three of these as usual.

traits.name: Telepathic Incubation
traits.description: The mass does not have any desire to converse with its prey, but while it is swallowing one or more creatures it gains knowledge of their languages, and can speak telepathically using their voices to any creatures within 240 feet of it. It is prone to using this method of communication to torment and mislead others it is hunting. It can also physically produce their voices, though they are labored and slow.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mass makes up to five Absorbing Tendril attacks, no more than two of which can be against the same target. It can also, instead, use its Overextended Grasp, then makes two Absorbing Tendril attacks.

actions.name: Absorbing Tendril
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage, and the target must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw, being grappled and restrained (escape DC 20) on a failure.

actions.name: Devouring Pods (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description:
The mass attempts to engulf each creature it is grappling by pulling them into its large, tube-like tendrils. Each target must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be swallowed (6 Medium creatures/30 damage/DC 20) and stored in an acid-filled pod within the tendril itself.

The mass shares the senses, resistances, immunities, and vulnerabilities of any creature it is currently swallowing, and benefits from any magical effects currently affecting them as well. These benefits remain until it starts its turn without the creature within it. A creature swallowed this way takes 3d8 acid damage at the start of their turn.

The mass regains hit points equal to half the acid damage its swallowed targets take.

actions.name: Overextended Grasp
actions.description: The mass targets up to four creatures within 60 feet of it and lashes out at them with over-extended tendrils. Each target must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, and on a failure the mass pulls them into an unoccupied space its choice within 15 feet of it, where they fall prone.
